summary: Create TikTok Shop product-video plans from product facts, photos, selling points, and English or Japanese audience context. This AI product video maker produces hooks, a ready-to-film script, shot beats, subtitle cues, localized titles, hashtags, and a product-page-safe CTA for product showcases, demonstrations, unboxings, reviews, and creator-led shopping videos.
